findings.summary: All 2H_A_L bars map deterministically to twelve fixed UTC two-hour blocks A through L; no off-grid bar or BID/ASK membership mismatch exists.
Only 615 of 4072 target 15M with-parent state evaluations (15.103143%) resolve a non-empty first-valid 2H parent level snapshot.
Every incomplete 2H bucket emits an explicit clear event; no prior parent context is bridged across incomplete required membership.
Per side, 53 15M scope resets classify as 1 source-partition start, 48 provider-gap resets, 4 scheduled weekend closures and 0 unknown resets.
All parent resolutions use only events first-valid at or before the local close; future-parent usage is zero.
